document.title: Text Item Nodes / CT Command
document.purpose: Record the first visible text-node implementation for Data Garden.

summary: Data Garden now supports text nodes created with the CT chord command. CT enters create_text mode, and the existing create-object organism emits the same CREATE_NODE semantic event used by rectangle and circle creation. The World Model creates a durable node with kind text, centered at the clicked world position.

command.name: Create Text
command.integration: CT is in COMMAND_NAMES and reducer command handling, parallel to CR and CC.

node-shape.canonical-keys: NODE_KEYS now includes zoom_min and zoom_max for all node kinds.

zoom-visibility.creation-policy: Text nodes get zoom_min and zoom_max centered around workspace.camera.scale.
zoom-visibility.projection-policy: Projection does not draw text node body/text outside its zoom range. Selection state may still exist, and selection/manipulation overlays can still describe a selected hidden text node.

behavior: Text nodes draw as canvas text at the projected node center.
The displayed string is node.title, falling back to node id if title is empty.
The fill field controls text color.
The node angle is passed to canvas text for simple rotation support.
Font sizing, wrapping, and rich text are intentionally not implemented yet.

bounds-and-hit-testing.bounds: Text nodes use the same rotated rectangle bounds as rect nodes, based on x, y, w, h, and angle.
bounds-and-hit-testing.hit-testing: Canvas picking still checks node canvas items first, then falls back to visible node world bounds so text nodes have a logical body hit target.
bounds-and-hit-testing.marquee: Marquee selection uses node world bounds and skips text nodes outside their current zoom range.

manipulation-policy.selection: Text nodes can be selected and moved by normal body dragging.
manipulation-policy.handles: Single text selections do not show size or rotate handles.
manipulation-policy.cycle: Clicking an already-selected text node does not enter the size/rotate manipulation cycle.
manipulation-policy.mixed-selection: Mixed selections containing text and at least one rectangle/circle can show stretch and rotate handles. Stretch repositions text nodes with the group but does not resize their text box. Rotate repositions text nodes around the group pivot but does not change their angle.

save-load.save: Text nodes are saved as normal nodes, with zoom_min and zoom_max included.
save-load.load: normalize_node() preserves text nodes and supplies zoom_min/zoom_max defaults for older files.
save-load.older-nodes: Rect and circle nodes normalize to broad always-visible zoom bounds.

undo-redo.policy: Text node create, update, move, size, rotate, delete, save, and load use the existing world revision and history paths.
undo-redo.full-world-snapshots: No new full-world snapshot behavior was added.

known-limitations: No text wrapping or rich text.
No inspector fields for zoom_min or zoom_max yet.
Font size does not yet scale to fit the logical text box.
Text nodes are move-only when selected alone. In mixed stretch selections, text nodes reposition with the group while preserving width and height.
Text visibility uses a simple numeric min/max scale range, not discrete zoom bands.
suggested-next-work: optional inspector controls for zoom range
font sizing based on text node height
